$comment: Example contract skill — safety boundaries for deployments.
Contract skills define negative boundaries: things the agent must
NEVER do. They are enforced automatically when the current operation
matches one of the 'requiredFor' risk tiers.
Unlike regular skills, contracts have no steps or triggers —
name: safe-deployment
constraints: NEVER auto-apply review fixes without explicit user approval
NEVER run destructive operations (drop, delete, force-push) without confirmation
NEVER bypass the consensus gate for build-affecting or higher changes
Always verify a rollback path exists before proceeding with deploy
